shared_elements: striated or banded rendering of hair/headdress
justification: Both depict human figures wearing tall elaborate headgear with striated/banded rendering, which is the only reasonably specific correspondence; A additionally carries disc and pendant motifs on the body that have no counterpart in B. Otherwise the content differs fundamentally: A is a single frontal, massive figure carved in the round with schematic, heavily abstracted body ornament, while B is a shallow relief scene of two bearded heads in profile facing each other with a raised hand between them, rendered with detailed curled beard and patterned garment conventions.
